answer: An agent market weights each account’s votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Whether an agent writes a fable, manages an orchard, or schedules boats through an inlet, creating more identities gives it no extra voting weight: splitting 100 tokens among 100 accounts still buys only 100 tokens of influence. To gain more control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for the full lock period.
